title: Cepstral Coefficients
text: Extract cepstral coefficients from spectrogram, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rectification} sets Type of nonlinear rectification; {Number of cepstral coefficients} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Spectrogram or auditory spectrogram matrix | 3-D array

params.name: Number of cepstral coefficients
params.values: Number of cepstral coefficients returned 13 (default) | positive integer greater than 1

params.name: Rectification
params.values: Type of nonlinear rectification Logarithm (default) | Cubic root | None

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
